prospects.thesis: Leidos offers a compelling combination of defense IT exposure and value pricing at just 0.9x sales, well below defense prime peers. The company benefits from sustained DoD digital modernization spending, classified cyber contracts, and Health Group tailwinds from VA/DHA work. Bullish options flow paired with institutional accumulation and +8.1% one-month momentum suggests smart money is positioning ahead of continued contract wins.

HII is the sole builder of U.S. nuclear-powered aircraft carriers and one of two Virginia-class submarine builders, giving it an irreplaceable moat as naval shipbuilding budgets expand amid Indo-Pacific tensions. At 1.0x P/S with +11.9% one-month momentum, the market is finally rewarding the multi-decade backlog visibility. Bullish options and institutional flows confirm the setup ahead of continued FY27 defense authorization tailwinds.

Snowflake is emerging as a core AI data infrastructure layer, with Cortex AI and Snowpark driving consumption growth as enterprises operationalize LLMs on proprietary data. The +19.9% one-month move reflects re-acceleration in product revenue and expanding AI workload attach rates. Bullish options positioning ahead of the late-August earnings print offers an event-driven entry catalyst.

SMCI remains the leading provider of liquid-cooled AI reference architecture servers built around NVIDIA Blackwell and AMD MI series GPUs, with direct exposure to hyperscaler and neocloud capex. At just 0.5x sales, the valuation reflects lingering audit overhang while the underlying AI server demand cycle remains intact. Bullish options and institutional accumulation suggest the risk/reward has skewed favorable post-consolidation.

Datadog is a direct beneficiary of AI-native customer workload growth, with LLM observability and AI integrations driving above-consensus usage from OpenAI-adjacent customers. While 26.7x sales is premium, bullish options flow and institutional support signal expectations for strong Q2 print. The +8.0% one-month momentum trails peers, suggesting room to run if earnings confirm AI cohort acceleration.
